cycle_init_utc.meaning: initialization of one HRRR product cycle

emulated_available_time_utc.meaning: historical time at which a cycle becomes legally usable

interval_support.meaning: right-open physical support for interval-valued fields
interval_support.storage: two timezone-aware UTC timestamps or explicit nulls

issue_time_local.meaning: issue time rendered in America/Denver with UTC offset
issue_time_local.storage: timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp plus timezone name

market_time_utc.meaning: causal market observation or decision time

model_ready_time_utc.meaning: issue time plus measured operational processing latency

truth_available_time_utc.meaning: time at which final daily outcome evidence can be known

valid_time_utc.meaning: physical time described by a forecast value

historical_availability.selection_rule: newest eligible cycle independently for each product

issue_grid.enumeration: UTC timeline filtered by local calendar membership

target_window.definition: [07:00Z on target_date, 07:00Z on target_date plus one day)
